A '''member''' of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a triple agent for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Kubaz provided the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Cartel with information that they gathered while undercover in both the Republic and the Empire, allowing the Cartel to take advantage of the warring [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] powers.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kubaz was mentioned in the Codex entry for Kubaz in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
